claims.text: Dupilumab (Dupixent) label: CSU in pts ≥ 2 y still Sxtomatic despite H1 antihistamine tx.
claims.quote: DUPIXENT is indicated for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients aged 2 years and older with chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) who remain symptomatic despite H1 antihistamine treatment.

claims.text: Dupilumab (targets IL-4 and IL-13) may reduce pruritus and severity in pts 12 and older still Sxtomatic despite antihistamines
claims.quote: Dupilumab, a monoclonal antibody that targets interleukins (IL)-4 and IL-13, is another agent that may also be helpful in reducing pruritus and severity of urticaria in patients aged 12 years and older who remain symptomatic despite antihistamine treatment (4).
